title: Tailoring Optimization Approaches with Domain Knowledge in Industry Process for Meta-heuristic Development
abstract: arXiv:2611.13940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The paper presents an Industry Process for Meta-heuristic Development (IPMD) schema, a systematic methodology for applying meta- and hyper-heuristic applications to optimization problems. In this context, we present a case study of Balancing Non-dominated Tournament Genetic Programming (BNTGP) applied to solve two NP-hard multi-objective optimization problems: routing (Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows) and scheduling (Multi-Skill Resource Constrained Project Scheduling Problem). The BNTGP method is based on a metaheuristic design. Its genetic programming-based representation makes BNTGP a hyper-heuristic, as it enables the exploration of a search space of heuristics for solving problems in general. The resulting heuristic can then be applied across a set of problem instances.

translated_title: 在面向元启发式开发的工业流程中利用领域知识定制优化方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了元启发式开发的工业流程（IPMD）框架，这是一种将元启发式和超启发式方法应用于优化问题的系统化方法论。在此背景下，我们展示了一个平衡非支配锦标赛遗传编程（BNTGP）的案例研究，用于求解两个NP难的多目标优化问题：路径规划类问题（带时间窗的容量约束车辆路径问题）和调度类问题（多技能资源受限项目调度问题）。BNTGP方法基于元启发式设计，其基于遗传编程的表示形式使BNTGP成为一种超启发式方法，因为它能够探索针对一般性问题求解的启发式搜索空间。所生成的启发式方法随后可应用于一系列问题实例。
tldr: 本文提出了元启发式开发的工业流程（IPMD）框架，并展示了一种基于遗传编程的超启发式方法BNTGP，成功应用于求解车辆路径和项目调度这两个NP难多目标优化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Industry Process for Meta-heuristic Development (IPMD) schema and demonstrates a genetic programming-based hyper-heuristic, BNTGP, to solve two NP-hard multi-objective optimization problems in vehicle routing and project scheduling.
